IN THE COURT OF LEARNED CIVIL JUDGE, PESHAWAR. 
 
 SHOUKAT ZAMAN 
 VS 
 FARUKH LATIF &amp; AN OTHER 
 
 APPLICATION FOR AND ON BEHALF OF DEFENDANT NO. 2 FOR SETTING ASIDE EX-PARTE PROCEEDINGS. 
 
 RESPECTFULLY SHEWETH: 
 The Applicant/Defendant No. 2 most earnestly craves the permission of this Hon’ble Court to submit as under: 
 
 That the titled suit was instituted against the defendants for the purpose of recovery. 
 
 That the instant case is currently fixed for hearing on 22-04-2026. 
 
 That on 30-03-2026 the Defendant No. 2 first gained knowledge that the aforementioned suit had been filed and was pending adjudication against the Defendant when the Counsel for Defendant visited the court premises to attend another case titled “ Bilaluddin vs Zameen.com”. 
 
 That upon obtaining and inspecting the case records, the Applicant/Defendant No. 2 discovered that this Honorable Court had proceeded ex- parte against them via an order dated 12-12-2025. From the date of knowledge, application is well within time. 
 
 That since valuable legal rights of the Applicant/Defendant are involved in this matter, it is essential that the Ex- Parte order be set aside. 
 
 That in the interest of justice, the Applicant/Defendant should be afforded a fair opportunity to defend their protected rights under the law. 
 
 PRAYER: 
 It is, therefore, most humbly prayed that on acceptance of this application, the Order dated 12-12-2025 may kindly be set aside and a proper opportunity be provided to the Applicants/defendants to contest the suit on its merits. 
 
 
 
 
 APPLICANTS / DEFENDANT NO.2 
 Through 
 
 
 TAIMUR NOOR 
 ADVOCATE 
 AFFIDAVIT 
 I, Mr. Syed Hasan Ali Shah , S/O Syed Ghulam Ali Shah do hereby solemnly affirm and declare that the contents of the accompanying APPLICATION are true and correct to the best of my knowledge and belief, and nothing has been concealed from this Hon’ble Court. 
 
 
 
 DEPONENT
